label: round 8, phase C — Wil's iOS 26 device pass
notes: Round 8 phase C, part 1 of 2. Numbered 10 only because scope-check discovers manifests by the regex -round-<digits>.json and 8 and 9 are taken by this same client round's phases A/A2 and B; it is still round 8. Ships two things, both invisible by construction: (1) the chapter address-bar strip goes 4px -> 12px and loses its @supports (-webkit-touch-callout: none) gate, which is what section 5.1 specified and not what phase B shipped — the reason no fill appeared on Wil's iPhone; (2) /glass-lab gains test 4, which probes strip height and the gate in PURE RED so the answer is 'red or brown?' rather than test 2's unusable 'which dark brown?'. scripts/scope-check.mjs is in scope for a one-function fix to manifest discovery: a lexical sort put -round-10 before -round-9, so from this manifest on, a bare `npm run qa:scope` would have gated against the wrong round. allowedRoutes is empty: every change is opacity 0, out of flow, or on an unlinked internal page, so no route may drift. Part 2 (the /map top matched-colour tint, section 5.5) is deliberately NOT in this manifest — Wil tests once, then it is built on what his phone says.
